cover_headline: Chevron Earnings Beat Estimates as Refining Surge Lifts Profit to $9.9 Billion on $67.8 Billion Revenue
facts: Adjusted earnings of $10.4 billion, or $5.28 per share, beat the $4.78 Zacks consensus by 10.5%, on revenue of $67.8 billion, up 36.3%
Downstream earnings climbed to $4.9 billion from $1.1 billion a year earlier, on record U.S. refinery throughput of 1.09 million barrels per day at 98% utilization
Free cash flow surged to $12 billion and total debt fell to $33.5 billion, and the board declared a $1.78 quarterly dividend payable December 10

quote.text: We delivered strong operational performance and disciplined execution, while continuing to invest to grow energy supply.
quote.speaker: Mike Wirth

end.headline: Chevron Earnings Beat Estimates as Refining Surge Lifts Profit to $9.9 Billion on $67.8 Billion Revenue
end.line: Adjusted EPS of $5.28 beat the $4.78 consensus as downstream earnings quadrupled on record refinery throughput, free cash flow hit $12 billion and debt fell again.
